candidates.label: Universal hamd spanning creation and Hereafter with Hakim-Khabir attributes
candidates.definition: In 34:1: Praise to Allah who owns whatever in heavens and earth; praise in Hereafter too; He is Wise Aware.

evidence.excerpt: ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ

candidates.label: Atom-weight accountability across heavens-earth demonstrating exhaustive divine knowledge
candidates.definition: In 34:3: Not even atom weight escapes Him in heavens or earth; smaller or larger in clear Book.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَأۡتِينَا ٱلسَّاعَةُۖ قُلۡ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتَأۡتِيَنَّكُمۡ عَٰلِمِ ٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ لَا يَعۡزُبُ عَنۡهُ مِثۡقَالُ ذَرَّةٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَآ أَصۡغَرُ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكۡبَرُ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ

candidates.label: Dawud iron-softening as divinely granted technological capacity
candidates.definition: In 34:10-11: We softened iron for Dawud; make coats of mail measure links precisely.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا دَاوُۥدَ مِنَّا فَضۡلٗاۖ يَٰجِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُۥ وَٱلطَّيۡرَۖ وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ ٱلۡحَدِيدَ

candidates.label: Sulayman wind-copper-jinn subjection as comprehensive dominion grant
candidates.definition: In 34:12: Wind morning-month evening-month; copper fountain flowed; jinn worked making statues basins pots.

evidence.excerpt: وَلِسُلَيۡمَٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهۡرٞ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهۡرٞۖ وَأَسَلۡنَا لَهُۥ عَيۡنَ ٱلۡقِطۡرِۖ وَمِنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ مَن يَعۡمَلُ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِۦۖ وَمَن يَزِغۡ مِنۡهُمۡ عَنۡ أَمۡرِنَا نُذِقۡهُ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

candidates.label: Gratitude as condition for sustained divine favor: few servants are grateful
candidates.definition: In 34:13: Work righteousness O family of David; few of My servants are grateful (shakur).

evidence.excerpt: يَعۡمَلُونَ لَهُۥ مَا يَشَآءُ مِن مَّحَٰرِيبَ وَتَمَٰثِيلَ وَجِفَانٖ كَٱلۡجَوَابِ وَقُدُورٖ رَّاسِيَٰتٍۚ ٱعۡمَلُوٓاْ ءَالَ دَاوُۥدَ شُكۡرٗاۚ وَقَلِيلٞ مِّنۡ عِبَادِيَ ٱلشَّكُورُ

candidates.label: Saba prosperity-to-destruction arc: gardens replaced by bitter fruit after ingratitude
candidates.definition: In 34:15-17: Two gardens right-left; ate provision thanked; turned away sent Arim flood; replaced with bitter tamarisk lotus.

evidence.excerpt: لَقَدۡ كَانَ لِسَبَإٖ فِي مَسۡكَنِهِمۡ ءَايَةٞۖ جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٖ وَشِمَالٖۖ كُلُواْ مِن رِّزۡقِ رَبِّكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لَهُۥۚ بَلۡدَةٞ طَيِّبَةٞ وَرَبٌّ غَفُورٞ

candidates.label: Inter-town visible stages enabling safe travel as infrastructure blessing
candidates.definition: In 34:18: Made between them visible towns determined stages; travel nights days in safety.

evidence.excerpt: وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡقُرَى ٱلَّتِي بَٰرَكۡنَا فِيهَا قُرٗى ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَقَدَّرۡنَا فِيهَا ٱلسَّيۡرَۖ سِيرُواْ فِيهَا لَيَالِيَ وَأَيَّامًا ءَامِنِينَ

candidates.label: Self-inflicted wrong acknowledged at punishment moment as belated recognition
candidates.definition: In 34:21: When they saw punishment said we wronged ourselves; how can we be returned?

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ مِنۡهَا فِي شَكّٖۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ

candidates.label: Believer reward as forgiveness plus noble provision
candidates.definition: In 34:4: Those who believed and did righteous deeds have forgiveness and noble provision.

evidence.excerpt: لِّيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ

candidates.label: Disbeliever sign-frustration producing Fire punishment
candidates.definition: In 34:5: Those who strive against Our signs to frustrate them have painful Fire punishment.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوۡ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٞ

candidates.label: False deity total impotence: no possession no partnership no intercession
candidates.definition: In 34:22: Say call those besides Allah; they own nothing in heavens-earth; no share no partner no helper.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱدۡعُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمۡتُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا لَهُمۡ فِيهِمَا مِن شِرۡكٖ وَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡهُم مِّن ظَهِيرٖ

candidates.label: Intercession exclusively by divine permission negating autonomous mediation
candidates.definition: In 34:23: Intercession does not avail except for whom He permits.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِمَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُۥۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلُوبِهِمۡ قَالُواْ مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمۡۖ قَالُواْ ٱلۡحَقَّۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ

candidates.label: Dispute without knowledge-guidance-scripture as triple epistemological deficit
candidates.definition: In 34:24: They dispute about Allah without knowledge without guidance without enlightening book.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ مَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوۡ إِيَّاكُمۡ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوۡ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

candidates.label: Ancestral tradition following despite satanic misdirection toward Blaze
candidates.definition: In 34:21: When told follow what Allah revealed say follow fathers; even if Satan invites to Blaze?

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنٍ إِلَّا لِنَعۡلَمَ مَن يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ مِنۡهَا فِي شَكّٖۗ وَرَبُّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيظٞ

candidates.label: Creation-truth-term triad establishing purposeful finite cosmos
candidates.definition: In 34:27: Created heavens earth in truth with appointed term; most disbelieve meeting Lord.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَرُونِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَلۡحَقۡتُم بِهِۦ شُرَكَآءَۖ كَلَّاۚ بَلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ

candidates.label: Travel-observation methodology confirming historical destruction pattern
candidates.definition: In 34:28: Travel earth observe end of those before; Allah destroyed them; not unjust they wronged selves.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Provision attribution test: who provides from heaven and earth? They say Allah
candidates.definition: In 34:24: Say who provides you from heavens earth? Say Allah; indeed we or you are guided or in clear error.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ مَن يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ قُلِ ٱللَّهُۖ وَإِنَّآ أَوۡ إِيَّاكُمۡ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى أَوۡ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ

candidates.label: Gathering-judgment with Fattah-Alim attributes establishing divine arbitration
candidates.definition: In 34:26: Say our Lord gathers us then judges between us in truth; He is Fattah Aleem.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ يَجۡمَعُ بَيۡنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفۡتَحُ بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلۡفَتَّاحُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

candidates.label: Desire-following producing sealed hearts as consequential misguidance
candidates.definition: In 34:28: Whoever follows his desire without knowledge; Allah sealed his hearing heart.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Closing hamd with sign-recognition promise affirming divine awareness
candidates.definition: In 34:28: Say praise to Allah; He will show you His signs and you will recognize them; Lord not unaware.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ

candidates.label: Individual standing before Allah in pairs-singles for reflective accountability
candidates.definition: In 34:46: Say I exhort you to one thing: stand before Allah in pairs and individuals then reflect.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍۖ أَن تَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ مَثۡنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُواْۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ لَّكُم بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٖ

candidates.label: Companion-not-jinn clarification establishing prophetic mental soundness
candidates.definition: In 34:46: Your companion is not possessed (majnun); he is warner before severe punishment.

evidence.excerpt: ۞قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍۖ أَن تَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ مَثۡنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُواْۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ لَّكُم بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ عَذَابٖ شَدِيدٖ

candidates.label: Reward separation: prophet asks no wage; audience reward is their own
candidates.definition: In 34:47: Say whatever reward I asked is for you; my reward is only from Allah; He is Witness over everything.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ مَا سَأَلۡتُكُم مِّنۡ أَجۡرٖ فَهُوَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٞ

candidates.label: Fattah-Rahim encompassing mercy with transgressor-specific punishment
candidates.definition: In 34:48: Say indeed my Lord originates and returns; He inspired me with mercy encompassing everything; assign transgressors painful punishment.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِنَّ رَبِّي يَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَّـٰمُ ٱلۡغُيُوبِ

candidates.label: Jinn-human assembly at gathering with eternal fire abode
candidates.definition: In 34:49: Day He gathers all; says O assembly of jinn and men; fire is your abode eternally except Allah wills.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

candidates.label: Self-testimony against disbelief acknowledging worldly delusion
candidates.definition: In 34:49: They testify against themselves that they were disbelievers; deluded by worldly life.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

candidates.label: Wealth-children as dunya adornment versus enduring good deeds as superior
candidates.definition: In 34:37: Wealth and children are adornment of worldly life; enduring good deeds better with Lord for reward-hope.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِي تُقَرِّبُكُمۡ عِندَنَا زُلۡفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعۡفِ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ

candidates.label: Truth-falsehood dynamic: truth arrives falsehood cannot originate or repeat
candidates.definition: In 34:49: Say truth has come; falsehood cannot originate (yubdi') nor repeat (yu'id).

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ

candidates.label: Error-consequence borne individually while guidance comes through revelation
candidates.definition: In 34:50: Say if I err I err against myself; if guided it is by what Lord revealed; He is Hearing Near.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ إِن ضَلَلۡتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِيۖ وَإِنِ ٱهۡتَدَيۡتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِيٓ إِلَيَّ رَبِّيٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٞ قَرِيبٞ

candidates.label: Belated belief rejected: faith does not benefit when punishment is seen
candidates.definition: In 34:52: They said we believe in it; but how can faith reach them from distant place? Belated belief void.

evidence.excerpt: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ
